exposure: Timing of extubation (early within 24 hours vs late after 24 hours)
Timing of surfactant administration (at or before 6 hours of age vs after 6 hours of age)
cohort: 90 infants treated with surfactant replacement therapy for respiratory distress syndrome.
finding: Early extubation (within 24 hours) after surfactant replacement therapy for respiratory distress syndrome was associated with shorter duration of CPAP, total oxygen administration, and hospital stay.
